answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake assets like rare timber and ivory licenses. A game-theoretic multi-agent auditing protocol isolates suspicious subgraphs behind a topological cut, pooling contested collateral into a lagoon escrow. Honest auditors cross-verify agent interactions; if cut verifications detect coordinated voting fraud, malicious stakes suffer complete stake slashing. This enforces superlinear attacker cost scaling as O(N^2).
